design: Purposive, bounded illustrative sample of retained completed-run metadata and full job pages. Not a random sample, exact latest-N workflow sample, causal experiment, account-wide utilization window, or comprehensive outcome cohort.
raw_notes: raw/*.json are retained GitHub connector response contents, without derived workflow/event/window projections.

The retained job listings use the run jobs endpoint with per_page=100 and pagination. Added parent-audit pages used the default latest filter; some initial audit pages explicitly used filter=all. Every selected run and every retained job has run_attempt=1, so either response represents that one complete attempt. Job pages are mapped byte-for-byte to attempt-1 replay names; this is a documented projection, not an original attempt-endpoint response.

Canonical metadata source per selected run is https://api.github.com/repos/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/RUN_ID. Some retained metadata came from repository-wide filtered run listings, as indicated by selected_runs[].metadata; these are not claimed to be responses to workflow-specific endpoints.
The compare responses are later reads of each SHA against mutable main. They support merged ancestry at observation time, not queue causal history.

The CPU file is a retained timestamped excerpt of job 133904051095 logs, not a full log. The report-job file is an excerpt of the failed report job logs. No new workflows or hardware jobs were launched.
No actual configured hosted concurrency value was available; the collection capacity field is deliberately unknown.
